# Learning is Change

> Ben Wilkoff's blog since 2005: education, technology, and change — 3,600+ posts — plus a portfolio of native apps he designs and ships end to end.

Every post has a Markdown twin at the same URL plus `index.md`
(e.g. https://learningischange.com/2024/07/21/on-not-reading-the-news/index.md).
Structured data: BlogPosting on every post, CollectionPage on archives, Person/WebSite on the homepage.

## Start here

- [About Ben](https://learningischange.com/portfolio/about/): who writes this
- [Important posts](https://learningischange.com/important-posts/): the posts that resonated most
- [The Ripe Environment](https://learningischange.com/2007/06/07/the-ripe-environment/): the framework at the heart of the blog
- [All posts by year](https://learningischange.com/all-posts/): complete index, 2005–present
